youtube.title: Napoleon edited his MULE into a horse 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Napoleon crossing the Alps: the painting vs. the reality 💀

What's the most edited pic YOU'VE ever posted? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in May 1800 Napoleon crossed the Great St Bernard Pass on a sure-footed mule, led by a local guide. In 1801 Jacques-Louis David painted him on a rearing stallion — Napoleon reportedly asked to be shown "calm on a fiery steed". In 1850 Paul Delaroche painted the realistic version: tired Napoleon, on a mule, with the guide.
